name: skrim-site
description: skrim.app — the privacy policy, the recovery page, and the waitlist. Not the extension.

scripts.db:list: wrangler d1 execute skrim-waitlist --remote --command="SELECT email, datetime(created_at,'unixepoch') AS joined, source FROM waitlist ORDER BY created_at DESC"
scripts.db:count: wrangler d1 execute skrim-waitlist --remote --command="SELECT count(*) AS total FROM waitlist"
